brief:
Senior United Nations officials delivered a stark warning to the Security Council, declaring that conditions in the occupied West Bank have reached an unprecedented "dangerous turning point," Shehab Wire reported. The officials identified record-high settlement expansion and intensifying settler violence as primary drivers of the escalating crisis across Palestinian territories.

UN assessments detailed in the reports characterize the pattern of Israeli settlement activity and control as amounting to de facto annexation of West Bank land. Officials stressed that the current trajectory represents a critical juncture requiring urgent international intervention to prevent further deterioration of the humanitarian and political situation.
